name: STARCLASH
summary:
Step into an animated world where you are the main character.

STARCLASH is a cinematic immersive VR experience that puts you at the center of your own journey to becoming a star.

Instead of simply watching the story unfold on a screen, you step inside it. Meet colorful characters, experience dramatic moments up close, and feel the music and performances happening all around you as your story moves toward the spotlight.
